source.title: Complex algebraic geometry applied to integrable dynamics: concrete examples and open problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL with identifier 6985884 and source name 6985884.

Direct fetch of https://zbmath.org/6985884 returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge. The zbMATH REST API record for identifier 6985884 succeeded and identified the exact work as E. Previato, Complex algebraic geometry applied to integrable dynamics: concrete examples and open problems, Geometric methods in physics XXXV, Trends in Mathematics, pages 277-288 (2018).

Resolver metadata supplied DOI 10.1007/978-3-319-63594-1_28 and the source volume Geometric Methods in Physics XXXV. Metadata was used only for identity and candidate discovery, not as extraction evidence.

Bounded exact-work recovery used the DOI, exact title, and exact title plus PDF/Springer searches. EurekaMag matched the DOI and title but exposed only bibliographic metadata and a paid full-text request. Springer/DOI fetches could not be read in the local shell because DNS resolution failed. Other indexed pages found during recovery were citation-only pages or different works and were rejected.

A candidate proceedings PDF at https://zakharov.itp.ac.ru/pub/data/2018/2018-02-978-3-319-63594-1.pdf and Scribd previews matched the volume table of contents and listed the Previato chapter, but neither yielded a readable full-text artifact in the local workflow. Search snippets and table-of-contents previews were rejected as insufficient technical source text.
No document map was created because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the chapter's problem statements was recovered.

No open-question candidates were extracted because the workflow did not use resolver metadata, bibliographic landing pages, abstracts, search snippets, table-of-contents previews, or related works as technical evidence.

Source adequacy failed with failure modes blocked_or_challenged for the zbMATH page, network_or_dns_failure for DOI/Springer/PDF fetch attempts in the local shell, metadata_only for resolver and bibliographic pages, and missing_or_invalid_artifact for preview/snippet-only candidates.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/6985884.json and outputs/latest.json.
